observer: LD_PRELOAD process constructor/destructor; timings differ from headline benchmark boundary

findings.volatile: Observed frequency regime changes, approximately 4.6 GHz to 800 MHz, explain roughly 5.7x CPU-time changes on identical native programs. Slow bodies consume CPU rather than wait. State-size threshold is confounded by this policy; no fixed pipe timeout was observed.
findings.persistent: Every Commit rewrites MAGIC + 64-byte environment identity + four u64 fields (message,state,response limits and state length) + canonical state + SHA256; fsync temporary, rename, fsync directory. No separate response/registry/idempotency metadata; application receipts are in canonical state.
findings.perf: Denied by perf_event_paranoid=4; no system settings changed.
